_comment: LLM API pricing + spend caps for the budget guard (llm_budget.py). Rates in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Confirm against https://docs.claude.com pricing at wire time. Discount multipliers: batch=0.5, cache_read=0.1 (cached input only), cache_write=1.25.
_comment_local: S132: local models (ollama on either box, the TP=2 vLLM endpoint on cumulus1) are priced at $0 so llm_providers.call() can record their VOLUME to the ledger at a true cost. A local model missing here is still recorded, flagged unpriced at unknown_model_out_per_m -- add it rather than let the ceiling stand.

search_per_1k._source: S136: ONE price table for web-search TOOL calls, read by search_usage.report() on each box and by runner/llm_spend_report.py on the Mac. brave 5.0 = Search plan $5/1k with $5 free credit/mo (docs/PAID-ACCESS-REGISTRY.md:35). claude 10.0 = web_search_20260209 $10/1k (PAID-ACCESS-REGISTRY.md:104, cirrus_daily.py:577). gemini 0.0 = grounding ASSUMED within the free tier -- not verified against the vendor page; set the real rate when known.
